message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Go

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        platform: [macos-latest, ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        go-version: ["1.24", "stable"]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.platform }}
    steps:
      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}

      - name: Download Go dependencies
        run: go mod download
        env:
          GOPROXY: "https://proxy.golang.org"

      - name: Build
        run: go build -v ./...

      - name: Test
        run: go test -v ./...

  changelog:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # the check looks for the tag of the latest version

      - name: Check changelog entries
        run: scripts/check-changelog.sh

  test-386:
    # 32-bit int and uint. linux/amd64 runs 386 binaries natively.
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GOARCH: "386"
    steps:
      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: stable

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}

      - name: Download Go dependencies
        run: go mod download
        env:
          GOPROXY: "https://proxy.golang.org"

      - name: Build
        run: go build -v ./...

      - name: Test
        run: go test ./...
",
  "rationale": "Applies P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency download caching), supported by the measured experiment batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9 (6.06% elapsed savings) which adds actions/cache@v4 for ~/go/pkg/mod keyed on runner.os and hashFiles('go.mod','go.sum') before the dependency install step. This Go workflow repeatedly runs `go mod download` across a six-cell build matrix and the test-386 job, and the repository provides go.mod and go.sum, so the cache inputs exist and repeated dependency fetching is measurable. Every build/test step and required check is preserved; `go mod download` is kept to populate/warm the cache. No permissions are weakened, no secrets or privileged actions are added, and no publishing/deployment or new network access is introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
